decisions.reason: This flagship electric infrared panel line extends the firm's core infrared knowledge toward electrification, and in-house R&D lets it interpret results and keep refining the models.

The halogen heater is a niche addition built on established infrared know-how and costs little to keep within a broad range, so there is no clear evidence for withdrawal yet, though it is the most likely candidate for pruning.

The multi-model industrial electric hall heater serves the firm's core hall market, where accumulated knowledge and the field-service network give strong ability to learn from results and improve the line.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world deployment, built on core gas-radiant expertise and aligned with the firm's low-carbon direction.
